versos.grego: Τεκνία μου, ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε. καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ, Παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον·

controles.web: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
controles.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
controles.livre: Meus filhinhos, vos escrevo estas coisas para que não pequeis; mas se alguém pecar, temos um advogado com o Pai: Jesus Cristo, o justo.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ἱλασμός ἐστιν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν, οὐ περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ ὅλου τοῦ κόσμου.

controles.web: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
controles.kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
controles.livre: E ele é o sacrifício para perdão dos nossos pecados; e não somente dos nossos, mas também dos de todo o mundo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν, ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν.

controles.web: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
controles.kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
controles.livre: E nisto sabemos que o conhecemos, se guardamos os seus mandamentos.

versos.grego: ὁ λέγων ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτόν, καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ μὴ τηρῶν, ψεύστης ἐστίν, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν·

controles.web: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
controles.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
controles.livre: Aquele que diz: “Eu o conheço”, mas não guarda os seus mandamentos, é mentiroso, e nele não está a verdade.

versos.grego: ὃς δ’ ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ τετελείωται. Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐσμεν·

controles.web: But whoever keeps his word, God’s love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:
controles.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
controles.livre: Mas quem guarda a sua palavra, nele verdadeiramente o amor de Deus tem se aperfeiçoado; nisso sabemos que estamos nele.

versos.grego: ὁ λέγων ἐν αὐτῷ μένειν ὀφείλει καθὼς ἐκεῖνος περιεπάτησεν καὶ αὐτὸς οὕτως περιπατεῖν.

controles.web: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
controles.kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
controles.livre: Aquele que diz que está nele também deve andar como ele andou.

versos.grego: Ἀγαπητοί, οὐκ ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ’ ἐντολὴν παλαιὰν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς· ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ παλαιά ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ἠκούσατε.

controles.web: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
controles.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
controles.livre: Amados, não vos escrevo um mandamento novo, mas sim o mandamento antigo, que tivestes desde o princípio. Este mandamento antigo é a palavra que ouvistes.

versos.grego: πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει.

controles.web: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.
controles.kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
controles.livre: Mas também vos escrevo um mandamento novo, que é verdadeiro nele e em vós; pois as trevas passaram, e a verdadeira luz já ilumina.

versos.grego: Ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι.

controles.web: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
controles.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
controles.livre: Aquele que diz que está na luz, e odeia seu irmão, até agora está nas trevas.

versos.grego: ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει, καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν·

controles.web: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
controles.kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
controles.livre: Aquele que ama o seu irmão está na luz, e nele não há motivo algum para pecar.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ, καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
controles.kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
controles.livre: Mas aquele que odeia seu irmão está nas trevas, anda nas trevas, e não sabe para onde vai, pois as trevas lhe cegaram os olhos.

versos.grego: Γράφω ὑμῖν, τεκνία, ὅτι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι διὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
controles.kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
controles.livre: Filhinhos, vos escrevo porque pelo nome dele os vossos pecados são perdoados.

versos.grego: γράφω ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς· γράφω ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.

controles.web: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.   I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.   I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
controles.kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
controles.livre: Pais, vos escrevo porque conheceis aquele que é desde o princípio. Jovens, vos escrevo porque vencestes o maligno. Crianças, vos escrevi porque conheceis o Pai.

versos.grego: ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, παιδία, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν Πατέρα. ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς. ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι ἰσχυροί ἐστε καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν μένει καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.

controles.web: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.   I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
controles.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
controles.livre: Pais, vos escrevi porque conheceis aquele que é desde o princípio. Jovens, vos escrevi porque sois fortes, a palavra de Deus está em vós, e vencestes o maligno.

versos.grego: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ. ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον, οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ·

controles.web: Don’t love the world, neither the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
controles.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
controles.livre: Não ameis o mundo, nem as coisas que há no mundo. Se alguém ama o mundo, o amor do Pai não está nele.

versos.grego: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονία τοῦ βίου, οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός, ἀλλὰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐστίν.

controles.web: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
controles.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
controles.livre: Pois tudo o que há no mundo, a cobiça da carne, a cobiça dos olhos, e a ostentação da vida, não é do Pai, mas do mundo.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία αὐτοῦ· ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
controles.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
controles.livre: O mundo passa, e também a sua cobiça; mas aquele que faz a vontade de Deus permanece para sempre.

versos.grego: Παιδία, ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν, καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἀντίχριστοι πολλοὶ γεγόνασιν· ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν.

controles.web: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
controles.kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
controles.livre: Filhinhos, é a última hora. E como ouvistes que o anticristo vem, já agora muitos anticristos chegaram. Por isso sabemos que é a última hora.

versos.grego: ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξῆλθαν, ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν· εἰ γὰρ ἐξ ἡμῶν ἦσαν, μεμενήκεισαν ἂν μεθ’ ἡμῶν· ἀλλ’ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν πάντες ἐξ ἡμῶν.

controles.web: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
controles.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
controles.livre: Eles saíram de nós, mas não eram dos nossos, pois se fossem dos nossos, continuariam conosco; mas o que aconteceu foi para tornar claro que todos eles não eram dos nossos.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμεῖς χρῖσμα ἔχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ οἴδατε πάντες.

controles.web: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
controles.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
controles.livre: Vós, porém, tendes a unção do Santo, e todos vós tendes conhecimento.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, ἀλλ’ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν, καὶ ὅτι πᾶν ψεῦδος ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἔστιν.

controles.web: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
controles.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
controles.livre: Eu vos escrevi, não porque não conheceis a verdade, mas sim, porque a conheceis, e porque nenhuma mentira vem da verdade.

versos.grego: Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ Χριστός; οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος, ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὸν Υἱόν.

controles.web: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
controles.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
controles.livre: Quem é o mentiroso, senão aquele que nega que Jesus é o Cristo? Esse é o anticristo, que nega o Pai e o Filho.

versos.grego: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν Υἱὸν οὐδὲ τὸν Πατέρα ἔχει· ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ τὸν Πατέρα ἔχει.

controles.web: Whoever denies the Son, the same doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
controles.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
controles.livre: Quem nega o Filho também não tem o Pai; aquele que confessa o filho também tem o Pai.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς, ἐν ὑμῖν μενέτω. ἐὰν ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἠκούσατε, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ μενεῖτε.

controles.web: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
controles.kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
controles.livre: O que ouvistes desde o princípio permaneça em vós. Se o que ouvistes desde o princípio permanecer em vós, também permanecereis no Filho e no Pai.

versos.grego: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν, τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
controles.kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
controles.livre: E esta é a promessa que ele nos prometeu: a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
controles.kjv: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
controles.livre: Estas coisas vos escrevi acerca dos que vos tentam vos enganar.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μένει ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς· ἀλλ’ ὡς τὸ αὐτοῦ χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων, καὶ ἀληθές ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ψεῦδος, καὶ καθὼς ἐδίδαξεν ὑμᾶς, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
controles.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
controles.livre: E a unção que recebeste dele continua em vós, e não tendes necessidade de que alguém vos ensine; mas, como a unção dele vos ensina tudo, e é verdadeira, e não mentira, e como ela vos ensinou, assim nele permanecei.

versos.grego: Καὶ νῦν, τεκνία, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐὰν φανερωθῇ σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
controles.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
controles.livre: E agora, filhinhos, permanecei nele; a fim de que, quando ele se manifestar, tenhamos confiança, e não sejamos envergonhados diante dele na sua vinda.

versos.grego: ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν, γινώσκετε ὅτι καὶ πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται.

controles.web: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
controles.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
controles.livre: Se sabeis que ele é justo, sabeis que todo aquele que pratica a justiça é nascido dele.
